address: 334 Lexington Ave., New York, NY, 10016, USA
bio: Chef Jae Jung’s Kjun brings together Korean and Cajun cooking through a perspective shaped by her Korean heritage and her experience working under the legendary Leah Chase at Dooky Chase in New Orleans. What began as a small neighborhood operation has grown into a larger Murray Hill restaurant centered on a thoughtful and approachable take on the intersection of these two culinary traditions. The menu combines Southern comfort and Korean flavors through dishes that reinterpret familiar ingredients and preparations without losing sight of either influence. Rice dishes, fried specialties, banchan and Louisiana-inspired classics sit comfortably alongside one another, creating a meal that feels distinctive without being forced.
